Subject: PO vs card procurement - next steps (FinOpsCo)

Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps from today’s discovery call: 

Summary:
- FinOpsCo is evaluating Redwood for inference across a few product teams; estimated first-year spend ~ $120k.
- Procurement preference: appears to favor purchase orders for larger vendor agreements (>$50k), but they can accept card for proof-of-concept/short pilots.
- Vendor onboarding: AP requires W9, insurance cert, and SOC2 evidence for new vendors. Onboarding timeline ~3-4 weeks.
- Marketplace interest: Alex asked whether an AWS Marketplace purchase or private listing is possible to simplify procurement.

Action items we agreed on:
1) I’ll attach a short SOW + preliminary quote for the initial scope (attached). Please share with procurement so they have numbers for the PO.
2) Alex — please introduce your procurement contact (procurement@finopsco.com) on reply so we can route vendor onboarding items.
3) We’ll check marketplace viability in parallel; Lauren/Rachel I’m looping you for enablement.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (draft)

If that looks right I’ll follow up with a version of the SOW tailored to the PO process and a vendor onboarding checklist.

Thanks,

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finopsco.com>

Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO vs card procurement - next steps (FinOpsCo)

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few notes from procurement side: 

- Confirmed: for anything above ~$50k we require a PO and standard vendor onboarding. For pilots < $10k we can usually do a corporate card.
- Onboarding docs we need: completed vendor form, W9, COI (insurance), SOC2 report (or link to attestation). We typically run the onboarding in parallel with contract review.
- Timeline: expect 3-4 weeks from vendor submission to first PO issuance unless expedited.
- Marketplace: we have an existing AWS Marketplace program and prefer that route when possible — it speeds up approvals and gives budget owners a familiar purchasing flow. If Redwood is able to publish on AWS Marketplace or do a private listing, that would be preferred.

I’m looping in procurement@finopsco.com so they have context. If you can send an updated SOW + vendor onboarding checklist, we’ll begin the internal submission.

—Alex
Alex Chen
